title: Recapitulation — Jesus finishes what Moses began
english: Last homily: Moses began; Jesus finished. The law is shadow; Christ is truth. Jordan’s crossing is baptism; Jericho the world; the lots are gifts.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: East and west one people
english: Two and a half and nine and a half are one people — Jews and nations in one Christ. The witness-altar keeps peace.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: SERIES CLOSEOUT — serve the Lord
english: [[Choose this day — we and our house will serve the Lord >> Bible:Joshua 24:15]]. Twenty-six homilies on Jesus son of Nun are complete in Rufinus’s Latin. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
